originating_goal: Install repository-native validation, receipt generation, collision prevention, and continuation for the GCAT capacity paper workstream.
release_condition: Release when a hosted workflow run on the exact PR head completes, its jobs and logs are inspected, the gcat-capacity-validation artifact is inspected, and the result is recorded in a committed receipt or PR comment; otherwise expire automatically at claim_expires_at.
collision_boundaries: Do not rewrite simulation, sensitivity, figure, bibliography, or paper theory files except to repair validator-detected defects.
Do not alter Publisher activation, Site state, wiki propagation, release, deployment, or publication authority.
Do not duplicate PR #5 implementation ownership.
Do not mark COMPLETE without hosted workflow, log, and artifact evidence.

blocked_conditions.condition: No hosted workflow run exists on the automation commit.
blocked_conditions.release_event: A pull_request, push, or workflow_dispatch run starts on the exact branch head.
A committed review receipt identifies reviewer scope, equations checked, findings, and disposition.
A committed case-evidence note classifies each observation as sourced, first-person, qualified, or removed.

next_executable_task: Run the repository-native workflow, inspect all jobs and logs, download and inspect the artifact, then update the runtime receipt and release or renew this claim.
archive_condition: The session may archive after the workflow and task-state automation are committed and all remaining unique requirements are represented by this task state, the session goal inventory, the canonical handoff, PR #5, and Issue #6; observation of future workflow results may be owned by repository-native automation or Issue #6.
